name: io.github.Longado/ontopoc
title: OntoPoc
description: Ontology gate for AI agents: answers only from definitions a named person confirmed

environmentVariables.name: ONTOPOC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Address of the OntoPoc service, default http://127.0.0.1:8767. With a token, a host other than this machine needs https

environmentVariables.name: ONTOPOC_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Personal token from the OntoPoc AI tool access page; the service then acts as that person

environmentVariables.name: ONTOPOC_TOOLSET
environmentVariables.description: read: only the six read-only tools. all: every tool the token allows. Unset: the read tools without a token, what the token allows with one
